page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores using Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, the instance provides dedicated physical execution units without hyperthreading. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, which includes 94,489 GB of local hard disk drive (HDD) storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The instance does not include any graphics processing units (GPUs) or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge offers a high density of local HDD storage relative to its compute and memory resources, making it suitable for workloads requiring massive sequential data capacity rather than high-speed random IOPS. Appropriate workloads include large-scale data warehousing, log processing, distributed file systems, and cold storage archives where high-capacity local storage is required alongside moderate compute capabilities.
